title: Hexagram 1 The Creative
body: 乾為天. Strength and initiative; the time is ripe to push ahead, but beware of arrogance.

title: Hexagram 2 The Receptive
body: 坤為地. Yielding and embracing; cooperate and build patiently rather than taking the lead.

title: Hexagram 3 Difficulty at the Beginning
body: 水雷屯. Every beginning is hard; new life grows in the chaos. Secure your base and find helpers.

title: Hexagram 4 Youthful Folly
body: 山水蒙. Inexperience that needs guidance; learn humbly and don't jump to conclusions.

title: Hexagram 5 Waiting
body: 水天需. Wait for the right moment; danger lies ahead but will pass. Build your strength.

title: Hexagram 6 Conflict
body: 天水訟. Disputes and quarrels; seek compromise, insisting to the end brings loss.

title: Hexagram 7 The Army
body: 地水師. An army in the field; discipline and organization matter, with a just cause and a steady leader.

title: Hexagram 8 Holding Together
body: 水地比. Closeness and unity; choose your partners early, hesitation costs chances.

title: Hexagram 9 Small Taming
body: 風天小畜. Small savings, limited strength; keep accumulating, the time for big moves has not come.

title: Hexagram 10 Treading
body: 天澤履. Stepping on the tiger's tail; act carefully and respectfully to turn danger into safety.

title: Hexagram 11 Peace
body: 地天泰. Heaven and earth unite; everything flows smoothly, but guard against decline after the peak.

title: Hexagram 12 Standstill
body: 天地否. Blocked communication; defend rather than attack and wait for the turn.

title: Hexagram 13 Fellowship
body: 天火同人. Fellowship of shared goals; open and honest teamwork succeeds.

title: Hexagram 14 Great Possession
body: 火天大有. Great harvest, like the sun at noon; stay humble and share your abundance.

title: Hexagram 15 Modesty
body: 地山謙. Modesty brings benefit; work quietly and the result will be good.

title: Hexagram 16 Enthusiasm
body: 雷地豫. Joy and ease; move with the flow, but prepare and don't grow lazy.

title: Hexagram 17 Following
body: 澤雷隨. Follow the times and choose the good; flexible changes of direction help.

title: Hexagram 18 Work on the Decayed
body: 山風蠱. Long-standing decay needs repair; find the root cause and reform with resolve.

title: Hexagram 19 Approach
body: 地澤臨. Good fortune approaches; seize the moment, the good time does not last forever.

title: Hexagram 20 Contemplation
body: 風地觀. Observe and reflect; see the situation clearly and be an example to others.

title: Hexagram 21 Biting Through
body: 火雷噬嗑. Bite through the obstacle; clear rules and decisive action are needed.

title: Hexagram 22 Grace
body: 山火賁. Adornment and beauty; small things succeed, big things depend on substance.

title: Hexagram 23 Splitting Apart
body: 山地剝. Things fall away; wait quietly and conserve strength, do not act now.

title: Hexagram 24 Return
body: 地雷復. The light returns after darkness; start again, step by step.

title: Hexagram 25 Innocence
body: 天雷無妄. No reckless action; sincerity brings luck, scheming brings trouble.

title: Hexagram 26 Great Taming
body: 山天大畜. Great accumulation; a time to study and store up, then act when ready.

title: Hexagram 27 Nourishment
body: 山雷頤. Nourish body and mind; watch what you eat and say, care for yourself and others.

title: Hexagram 28 Great Exceeding
body: 澤風大過. The load is too heavy and the beam bends; extraordinary measures, but know your limits.

title: Hexagram 29 The Abysmal
body: 坎為水. Danger upon danger; stay sincere and calm and cross the difficulties step by step.

title: Hexagram 30 The Clinging
body: 離為火. Light that clings; find the right support and let your passion and talent shine.

title: Hexagram 31 Influence
body: 澤山咸. Mutual attraction and response; genuine connection without hidden motives is best.

title: Hexagram 32 Duration
body: 雷風恆. Endurance and persistence; keep to the right path and build for the long term.

title: Hexagram 33 Retreat
body: 天山遯. Retreat when the situation is unfavorable; stepping back protects you.

title: Hexagram 34 Great Power
body: 雷天大壯. Great strength; with power comes the duty to stay upright and avoid recklessness.

title: Hexagram 35 Progress
body: 火地晉. The sun rises and you advance; showing your ability wins recognition.

title: Hexagram 36 Darkening of the Light
body: 地火明夷. The light is wounded; hard times, hide your brilliance and protect yourself.

title: Hexagram 37 The Family
body: 風火家人. Harmony at home, everyone in their place; start by putting your own house in order.

title: Hexagram 38 Opposition
body: 火澤睽. Differing views pull apart; seek common ground, small matters can still succeed.

title: Hexagram 39 Obstruction
body: 水山蹇. The road is hard; stop, reflect and seek help instead of forcing through.

title: Hexagram 40 Deliverance
body: 雷水解. Difficulties dissolve and the clouds part; use the moment to settle what remains.

title: Hexagram 41 Decrease
body: 山澤損. Give up something to benefit others; give first and receive later, within your means.

title: Hexagram 42 Increase
body: 風雷益. Growth and progress with support; a good time to act and improve.

title: Hexagram 43 Breakthrough
body: 澤天夬. Decisive clearing; deal with the problem firmly, but wisely and watch for backlash.

title: Hexagram 44 Coming to Meet
body: 天風姤. An unexpected encounter; beware of temptation and unequal relationships.

title: Hexagram 45 Gathering Together
body: 澤地萃. People and resources gather; good for meetings, cooperation and uniting hearts.

title: Hexagram 46 Pushing Upward
body: 地風升. Steady ascent; keep your feet on the ground and you will rise.

title: Hexagram 47 Oppression
body: 澤水困. Exhausted and hemmed in; hold on to your beliefs and escape through action, not words.

title: Hexagram 48 The Well
body: 水風井. The well that feeds everyone; enrich your inner self and offer steady value.

title: Hexagram 49 Revolution
body: 澤火革. Revolution and renewal; change boldly when the time is ripe and the reason is right.

title: Hexagram 50 The Cauldron
body: 火風鼎. The cauldron sets a new order; stable success, a time to build and show your skill.

title: Hexagram 51 The Arousing
body: 震為雷. Thunder shakes, then calm returns; stay composed and you will gain.

title: Hexagram 52 Keeping Still
body: 艮為山. Stop where you should stop; pause and let things settle.

title: Hexagram 53 Development
body: 風山漸. Gradual progress; step by step, love and career grow steadily.

title: Hexagram 54 The Marrying Maiden
body: 雷澤歸妹. An improper bond and impulsive moves bring regret; think twice before acting.

title: Hexagram 55 Abundance
body: 雷火豐. Abundance at its peak; enjoy the present and prepare for the turn.

title: Hexagram 56 The Wanderer
body: 火山旅. A traveler without a fixed home; be careful and gentle, small things succeed.

title: Hexagram 57 The Gentle
body: 巽為風. Gentle like the wind; modest cooperation and repeated communication get things done.

title: Hexagram 58 The Joyous
body: 兌為澤. Joyful exchange; sincere cheerfulness wins hearts.

title: Hexagram 59 Dispersion
body: 風水渙. Scattering and dissolution; unite people and rebuild trust.

title: Hexagram 60 Limitation
body: 水澤節. Moderation; set limits and budgets, but don't be too harsh.

title: Hexagram 61 Inner Truth
body: 風澤中孚. Truth in the heart; sincerity moves others and can defuse a crisis.

title: Hexagram 62 Small Exceeding
body: 雷山小過. Slight excess; do small things and stay low-key, don't aim too high.

title: Hexagram 63 After Completion
body: 水火既濟. The task is done; keeping it is harder than winning it, don't relax too soon.

title: Hexagram 64 Before Completion
body: 火水未濟. Not yet finished, but hope remains; finish carefully, don't slip on the last step.

title: BaZi (Four Pillars)
body: Year, month, day and hour of birth each give a stem and a branch — eight characters used to read the balance of the five elements and the ten gods.

title: Day Master
body: The heavenly stem of the day pillar; it represents you, and every BaZi reading centers on it.

title: Strong or weak self
body: How much support the Day Master gets from peers and resources; a strong self likes to be drained, a weak self likes support.

title: Favorable element
body: The element that helps your chart most and brings the five elements into balance.

title: Hidden stems
body: Heavenly stems hidden inside each earthly branch, e.g. 寅 hides 甲, 丙 and 戊.

title: Luck Pillar
body: Ten-year periods in BaZi, counted forward or backward from the month pillar.

title: Annual pillar
body: The stem and branch of each year, interacting with your chart.

title: Zi Wei Dou Shu
body: Purple Star astrology: twelve palaces built from the lunar birthday and hour, read through star placements and the four transformations.

title: Body Palace
body: In Zi Wei, the palace that shows your acquired focus and the center of later life.

title: Element Bureau
body: Set by the nayin element of the Life Palace (Water 2, Wood 3, Metal 4, Earth 5, Fire 6); it places the Zi Wei star and the start of the decades.

title: Four transformations
body: Wealth, Power, Fame and Obstacle, set by the year stem — the dynamic key of Zi Wei.

title: Decade
body: In Zi Wei, each ten-year period is ruled by one palace.

title: Primary hexagram
body: The hexagram you cast; it shows the present situation.

title: Changed hexagram
body: What the moving lines turn into; it shows how things develop.

title: Nuclear hexagram
body: Lines 2–4 and 3–5 of the primary hexagram; the hidden process inside.

title: Moving lines
body: Lines that change (old yin, old yang); the key to the reading.

title: Three-coin method
body: Toss three coins six times from bottom to top; 6 and 9 are moving lines.

title: Plum Blossom numerology
body: Shao Yong's method of casting from numbers or time: upper trigram, lower trigram and a moving line.

title: Solar terms
body: Every 15° of the sun's longitude, 24 in a year; BaZi months start at the 'jie' terms and the year at Lichun.

title: Leap month
body: When 13 months fall between two winter solstices, the first month without a principal term is the leap month.

title: Nayin
body: The element given to each pair of the sixty stem-branch combinations, e.g. 甲子 and 乙丑 are Sea Metal.

title: Nine & Twelve
body: Birth year, month and day become three pillars; their sum gives the life number, which sets the Enneagram type and the Life Palace, then the twelve palaces are laid out backward and read as Favorable, Aligned or Adverse.

title: 1 · The Perfectionist
body: Principled, persevering, self-controlled. The rational, orderly type. They strive to keep standards and quality high, always attend to detail, and want to raise productivity. They habitually push others to improve, to become more effective and to do the right thing. Because they are so orderly, they can turn overly critical of themselves and of others. They dislike waste and carelessness, which can lead them to meddle in everything large and small, endlessly, and to offer criticism that is discouraging. At their best they judge soundly, decide wisely, become models of integrity and carry responsibility very well.

title: 2 · The Helper
body: Generous, grateful, gifted with people. The loving type, gifted at handling relationships. They are sensitive to what others need and always try to meet it. They appreciate other people's talents, can play confidant and guide, and are skilled with people. But they find it very hard to say no to a request, and the wish to help better puts them under great strain. They dislike impersonal working environments, which can make them play favourites and lose time in relationships. At their best they are empathetic and generous, and help a team build closer bonds.

title: 3 · The Achiever
body: Adaptable, ambitious, focused. The adaptable, ambitious type. They know how to get work done more efficiently and in line with what the client expects. They tend to be attractive, charming and full of energy, with sharp awareness of themselves, their team and the business. They like to be noticed and are often drawn to positions of success and prestige. They enjoy competition, and the need for status and personal advancement drives them to become workaholics — which can lead them to cut corners to stay ahead. At their best they become genuinely talented and admirable, and are often seen as the model that lifts everyone's morale.

title: 4 · The Individualist
body: Reflective, artistic, expressive. The reflective, artistically gifted type. Expressive, able to leave a deep impression, self-absorbed, with moods that shift without warning. The Individualist gives off a singular charm. On the standard they hold for good language, for originality and for their own mark on the work, they will not compromise. They dislike work with no creativity in it. They are over-sensitive to criticism, which can leave them moody and irregular in their work. At their best they bring intuition and creativity to what they do, improve it with a depth and a singularity of feeling that is theirs alone, and come to appreciate every other type.

title: 5 · The Investigator
body: Perceptive, curious, private. The keenly observant, argumentative type. Hungry to know, inventive, protective of privacy, eccentric. The Investigator is an energetic learner and experimenter, especially in technical fields. They like to follow their curiosity into the detail and explore the principle behind things. Their analytical power is strong, and they love discovery rather than scheduling time to commit to and build relationships. Unhealthy, they can turn arrogant, stop communicating with others and struggle constantly inside their own head. At their best the Investigator becomes far-sighted, able to bring wholly new ideas into the work.

title: 6 · The Loyalist
body: Hard-working, dependable, responsible. The attention-drawing, loyal type. Likeable, responsible, anxious, full of doubt. The Loyalist is hard-working and dependable, and can build the alliances at work that get things done more effectively. They can weigh other people's motives and merits, and look for the problems latent in a working environment. They dislike facing a crisis, want everyone to agree, and want to see the future coming. Without authority granted by the group they grow hesitant, find action very difficult and fall into blaming others. At their best the Loyalist is confident, independent and brave, and can often bring a team back to its founding values.

title: 7 · The Enthusiast
body: Versatile, optimistic, self-starting. The versatile, optimistic type. Self-starting, broadly talented, impulsive, with energy spread thin. The Enthusiast excels at change, variety, stimulation and innovation. They express themselves clearly, have a sense of humour, and can win other people over to their ideas. The Enthusiast always chases the trend, looking for new possibilities and new angles. They can run several jobs at once, but cannot keep at them. Unhealthy, they become talkative, scattered in attention and unfocused in energy, leaving much of their work half done. At their best the Enthusiast fixes their focus on a goal worth having and works with real efficiency.

title: 8 · The Challenger
body: Powerful, decisive, self-assured. The powerful, decisive type. Self-assured, authoritative, headstrong, confrontational. The Challenger knows exactly what they want to do and always has the capacity to do it well. They can make hard decisions, treat serious problems as a challenge to them, and overcome the difficulty in them. They want the commanding position, and find delegating a task or sharing leadership very hard. They are glad to support, protect and inspire others, but unhealthy they will threaten people into doing things their way, making unnecessary enemies inside the business and outside it. At their best the Challenger becomes magnanimous, using their strength to raise the standard of other people's lives.

title: 9 · The Peacemaker
body: Harmonious, easy-going, trustworthy. The harmonious, easy-going type. Highly accepting, trustworthy, complacent. The Peacemaker creates a harmonious team by emphasising what is positive in it, and so eases conflict and tension. They support and accommodate others, work well alongside people, and are humble. They dislike conflict in a team and always try to build harmonious, stable relations. But in going along with others they may avoid holding to their own view, and grow very angry inside. Unhealthy, their work becomes inefficient, stubborn and neglectful. At their best they can reconcile differences and draw people together into an environment that is stable and yet alive.
